verify-boundaries.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);path=o+'/boundary-controls/report.json';r=JSON.parse(File.read(path))
raise 'Incomplete boundaries' unless r['status']=='characterized'
r['identities'].merge(r['sources']).each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
keys=%w[kind width scenario calls mode]
expected=%w[array mixed struct].product([3,8,2048],%w[early_error late_error invalid read callback scalar],[1,2,16,32],%w[vm jit])
raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|keys.map{|k|x[k]}}.sort==expected.sort
expected_semantics=expected.select{|x|x[-1]=='vm'}.flat_map{|x|%w[baseline candidate].product(%w[vm interpreter jit]).map{|v,m|x[0..-2]+[m,v]}}
raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|(keys+['version']).map{|k|x[k]}}.sort==expected_semantics.sort
raise 'Semantic status' unless r['semantics'].all?{|x|x['exit']==0}
regressions=[]
r['rows'].each do |x|
 %w[requests bytes].each{|metric|regressions<<{case:keys.map{|k|x[k]},metric:metric,type:'total',delta:x['candidate'][metric]-x['baseline'][metric]} if x['candidate'][metric]>x['baseline'][metric]}
end
r['rows'].group_by{|x|%w[kind width scenario mode].map{|k|x[k]}}.each do |key,rows|
 [ [1,2],[16,32] ].each do |low,high|
  a=rows.find{|x|x['calls']==low};b=rows.find{|x|x['calls']==high}
  %w[requests bytes].each do |metric|
   before=b['baseline'][metric]-a['baseline'][metric];after=b['candidate'][metric]-a['candidate'][metric]
   regressions<<{case:key,metric:metric,type:'slope',calls:[low,high],delta:after-before} if after>before
  end
 end
end
result={status:regressions.empty? ? 'passed' : 'rejected',allocation_pairs:r['rows'].size,semantic_checks:r['semantics'].size,regressions:regressions,report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest,verifier_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest}
File.write(o+'/boundaries-verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(result)+"\n")
raise "Boundary allocation regressions: #{regressions.size}" unless regressions.empty?
puts 'All 432 boundary allocation pairs / 1296 semantic checks passed'

require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/memory-controls.json'))
raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='characterized'
bins={'baseline'=>File.expand_path('../capture-membership-2026-10-30/candidate-kujo',o),'candidate'=>o+'/candidate-kujo'}
raise 'Target identity' unless r['target_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/scalar-controls.json')
target=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/scalar-controls.json'));raise 'Target status' unless target['status']=='passed'
bins.each{|k,p|raise 'Binary identity' unless r['identities'][k]==sha.call(p)}
expected=%w[scalar-first collection-first scalar-only].product([3,2048],%w[once fresh],[32],%w[vm interpreter jit],[0,1])
raise 'Exact coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at('shape','width','snapshot','calls','mode','round')}.sort==expected.sort
sources={}
r['rows'].each do |row|
 ref=target['rows'].map{|x|x['baseline']}.find{|x|x.values_at('shape','width','snapshot','calls')==row.values_at('shape','width','snapshot','calls')}
 raise 'Fixture substitution' unless ref&&row['path']==ref['path']
 [row['path'],File.dirname(row['path'])+'/owner.kujo'].each{|p|sources[p]=sha.call(p)}
 bins.each do |kind,bin|
  x=row.fetch(kind);mode=row['mode'];argv=['/usr/bin/time','-l',bin,'run',row['path'],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode])
  raise 'Invocation/result' unless x['argv']==argv&&x['exit']==0&&x['stdout']=="SCALAR FIRST PASS\n"
  raise 'RSS evidence' unless x['rss_bytes']>0&&x['stderr'].scan(/(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size/)==[[x['rss_bytes'].to_s]]
 end
end
raise 'Source set' unless r['sources']==sources
groups=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('shape','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |group,rows|
 {group:group,observations:rows.map{|x|{round:x['round'],baseline:x['baseline']['rss_bytes'],candidate:x['candidate']['rss_bytes'],delta:x['candidate']['rss_bytes']-x['baseline']['rss_bytes']}}}
end
File.write(o+'/memory-verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate({status:'verified-needs-manual-review',pairs:72,groups:groups,report_sha256:sha.call(o+'/memory-controls.json'),verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__),limits:r['limits']})+"\n")
puts '72 exact memory pairs verified; manual tradeoff review required'

scalar-controls.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};bin=o+'/candidate-kujo';probe=o+'/task-allocation-probe'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,identities:[bin,probe].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},references:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(o+'/scalar-controls.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 %w[scalar-first-2026-10-30 scalar-first-small-2026-10-30].each do |name|
  ref=File.expand_path('../'+name+'/report.json',o);b=JSON.parse(File.read(ref));r[:references][ref]=sha.call(ref)
  raise 'Baseline status' unless b['status']=='characterized'&&b['rows'].size==96&&b['semantics'].size==144
  b['identities'].merge(b['sources']).each{|p,h|raise 'Baseline drift' unless sha.call(p)==h}
  b['rows'].each do |row|
   args=[probe,row['mode'],row['path']];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);m=stderr.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR FIRST PASS\n"&&m
   r[:rows]<<{baseline:row,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i};save.call
   next unless row['mode']=='vm'
   %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
    args=[bin,'run',row['path'],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
    raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR FIRST PASS\n"
    r[:semantics]<<{argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus};save.call
   end
  end
 end
 %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
  args=[bin,'run',o+'/contract/main.kujo','--untrusted']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
  raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR BATCH CONTRACT PASS\n"
  (r[:contracts]||=[])<<{argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus}
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==192&&r[:semantics].size==288
 r[:regressions]=r[:rows].select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x[k.to_sym]>x[:baseline][k]}}
 r[:slopes]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x[:baseline].values_at('shape','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |group,rows|
  a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:baseline]['calls']}.last(2)
  {group:group,bytes:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes])/16.0,requests:(b[:requests]-a[:requests])/16.0,baseline_bytes:(b[:baseline]['bytes']-a[:baseline]['bytes'])/16.0,baseline_requests:(b[:baseline]['requests']-a[:baseline]['requests'])/16.0}
 end
 r[:slope_regressions]=r[:slopes].select{|x|x[:bytes]>x[:baseline_bytes]||x[:requests]>x[:baseline_requests]}
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Candidate drift' unless sha.call(p)==h}
 r[:status]=r[:regressions].empty?&&r[:slope_regressions].empty? ? 'passed' : 'failed';save.call;raise 'Allocation regressions require review' unless r[:status]=='passed'
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

verify-fallback.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/fallback-controls/report.json'));raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='characterized'
sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};base=File.expand_path('../capture-membership-2026-10-30',o)
probes={'baseline'=>base+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'};binary=o+'/candidate-kujo'
raise 'Identities' unless r['identities']==(probes.values+[binary,o+'/fallback-controls.rb']).to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]}
keys=%w[shape payload form width calls mode];forms=%w[repeat other_key scalar read_root callback shared fresh error argument]
cases=%w[root].product(%w[array dictionary struct],forms,[2,2048],[1,2,16,32])
raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm interpreter jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
r['sources'].each{|h,s|raise 'Embedded fixture drift' unless Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)==h}
(r['rows']+r['semantics']).each do |x|
 p=o+'/fallback-controls/'+x.values_at(*keys.first(5)).join('-')+'/main.kujo'
 raise 'Fixture drift' unless sha.call(p)==x['source_sha256']&&sha.call(File.dirname(p)+'/owner.kujo')==x['module_sha256']
 if x.key?('exit')
  args=[binary,'run',p,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+x['mode'] unless x['mode']=='vm'
  raise 'Semantic execution' unless x['exit']==0&&x['argv']==args
 else
  probes.each{|k,probe|raise 'Probe command' unless x[k]['argv']==[probe,x['mode'],p]}
 end
end
regressions=r['rows'].select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x['candidate'][k]>x['baseline'][k]}}
slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('shape','payload','form','width','mode')}.flat_map do |g,rows|
 rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']}.each_slice(2).map{|a,b|{group:g,calls:[a['calls'],b['calls']],baseline:%w[requests bytes].to_h{|k|[k,(b['baseline'][k]-a['baseline'][k]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])]},candidate:%w[requests bytes].to_h{|k|[k,(b['candidate'][k]-a['candidate'][k]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])]}}}
end
bad=slopes.select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x[:candidate][k]>x[:baseline][k]}}
v={status:regressions.empty?&&bad.empty? ? 'passed' : 'rejected',pairs:432,semantics:648,total_regressions:regressions,slope_regressions:bad,slopes:slopes,report_sha256:sha.call(o+'/fallback-controls/report.json'),verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__)}
File.write(o+'/fallback-verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(v)+"\n")
raise "Rejected: #{regressions.size} totals / #{bad.size} slopes" unless v[:status]=='passed'
puts '432 fallback allocation pairs and 648 semantic checks passed without total/slope regressions'

verify-broad.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};read=->(p){JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/'+p))}
raise 'Covered gates incomplete' unless read.call('continuation-state.json')['status']=='review-pending'
raise 'Source drift' unless system('ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb')
# Match every prior test by name and status, not just a success substring.
tests=->(p){a=File.read(p).scan(/^test (\S+) \.\.\. (ok|ignored[^\n]*)$/);raise 'Duplicate test names' unless a.map(&:first).uniq.size==a.size;a.to_h}
previous=tests.call(File.expand_path('../capture-membership-2026-10-30/library-tests.log',o))
extra=%w[interpreter::indexed_publication::tests::promotion_preserves_scalar_bits_snapshots_and_replaced_owners interpreter::array_batch_proof::tests::admits_scalar_batches_without_displacing_two_write_storage]
current=tests.call(o+'/library-tests.log');raise 'Library test set/status drift' unless current==previous.merge(extra.to_h{|n|[n,'ok']})
raise 'Library result' unless File.read(o+'/library-tests.log').include?('1266 passed; 0 failed; 8 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out;')
prior_integration=tests.call(File.expand_path('../capture-membership-2026-10-30/integration-tests.log',o));raise 'Integration set/status' unless tests.call(o+'/integration-tests.log')==prior_integration.merge('scalar_first_array_batches::scalar_first_batches_preserve_snapshots_and_fallback_publication'=>'ok')
raise 'Integration result' unless File.read(o+'/integration-tests.log').include?('415 passed; 0 failed; 1 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out;')
i=read.call('integration-build-state.json');b=read.call('build-state.json')
raise 'Integration identity' unless i['status']=='passed'&&i['library_sha256']==b['library_sha256']&&i['binary_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/integration-harness')&&i['harness_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/integration-harness.rs')&&i['flags_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/current-link-flags.json')
i.fetch('test_sources').each{|p,h|raise 'Integration source drift '+p unless sha.call(p)==h}
reference=JSON.parse(File.read('benchmarks/langarena/test.json')).sort_by{|x|x['name']};raise 'Corpus cardinality' unless reference.size==50&&reference.map{|x|x['name']}.uniq.size==50
raise 'Checksums incomplete' unless read.call('checksum-state.json')['status']=='passed'
%w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
 r=read.call('all50-'+mode+'.json');raise 'Runtime identity' unless r['runtime']==mode&&r['binary']==o+'/candidate-kujo'
 raise 'Configuration set' unless r['results'].map{|x|x['config']}.sort_by{|x|x['name']}==reference
 r['results'].each do |x|
  raise 'Checksum row failure' unless x['status']=='passed'&&x['exitcode']==0&&x['runtime']==mode&&x['name']==x['config']['name']&&!x['stdout_truncated']&&!x['stderr_truncated']
  lines=x['stdout'].lines.map(&:chomp)
  raise 'Exact checksum output' unless lines.count(x['name']+': OK '+x['config']['checksum'].to_s)==1 && lines.count('Summary: 1, 1, 0')==1
 end
end
read.call('benchmark-source-manifest.json').each{|p,h|raise 'Benchmark source drift '+p unless sha.call(p)==h}
files=%w[build-state.json source-manifest.json continuation-state.json checksum-state.json benchmark-source-manifest.json library-tests.log integration-build-state.json integration-tests.log all50-vm.json all50-interpreter.json all50-jit.json format.log diff.log]
File.write(o+'/broad-verification.json',JSON.pretty_generate({status:'passed',library_passes:1266,library_ignored:8,integration_passes:415,integration_ignored:1,test_size_checksums:150,evidence_hashes:files.to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(o+'/'+p)]},verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__),limits:'This gate does not replace allocation, memory and final review acceptance. No production-size or clean-host claims.'})+"\n")
puts 'Exact source, complete test sets and all150checksum outputs verified'

accept.rb.text:
require 'json'
require 'digest'
o = File.expand_path(__dir__)
sha = ->(p) { Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest }
read = ->(p) { JSON.parse(File.read(o + '/' + p)) }
%w[verify-source verify-scalar-controls verify-batch verify-boundaries verify-fallback verify-broad verify-memory].each do |name|
  raise name unless system('ruby', o + '/' + name + '.rb')
end
raise 'Final queue unfinished' unless read.call('final-review-state.json')['status'] == 'review-pending'
review = read.call('memory-review.json')
raise 'Manual memory review missing' unless review['status'] == 'reviewed' && review['disposition'] == 'accept'
raise 'Memory review stale' unless review['report_sha256'] == sha.call(o + '/memory-controls.json')
raise 'Negative verifier cases' unless read.call('verifier-rejections.json')['status'] == 'passed'
files = %w[source-manifest.json additional-test-manifest.json normal-artifact-selection.json scalar-controls.json scalar-controls-verified.json batch-controls/report.json batch-verified.json boundary-controls/report.json boundaries-verified.json fallback-controls/report.json fallback-verified.json verifier-rejections.json broad-verification.json memory-controls.json memory-verified.json memory-review.json]
files += Dir[o + '/historical-gate-repair/**/*'].select { |p| File.file?(p) }.map { |p| p.delete_prefix(o + '/') }
File.write(o + '/acceptance-receipt.json', JSON.pretty_generate({
  status: 'accepted', scope: 'Eligible scalar-first and scalar-only captured-array batches; broader sections 3/4 remain open.',
  evidence_hashes: files.to_h { |p| [p, sha.call(o + '/' + p)] }, verifier_sha256: sha.call(__FILE__)
}) + "\n")
puts 'Scalar-first batch acceptance verified'

fallback-controls.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3';require 'fileutils'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);out=o+'/fallback-controls';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
base=File.expand_path('../capture-membership-2026-10-30',o);probes={'baseline'=>base+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'};binary=o+'/candidate-kujo'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,identities:(probes.values+[binary,__FILE__]).to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
forms=%w[repeat other_key scalar read_root callback shared fresh error argument]
begin
 %w[array dictionary struct].product(forms,[2,2048],[1,2,16,32]).each do |payload,form,width,calls|
  shape='root'
  d=out+'/'+[shape,payload,form,width,calls].join('-');FileUtils.mkdir_p(d)
  seed='[]'
  insert='seed = push(seed, Item { value: 0 })'
  declaration=shape=='root' ? 'mut state := seed' : shape=='deep' ? 'mut state := {"branch": {"row": seed}}' : 'mut state := [seed]'
  row=shape=='root' ? 'state' : shape=='deep' ? 'state["branch"]["row"]' : 'state[0]'
  replacement=case form;when 'callback';'Item { value: observe(n) }';when 'nested_literal';'Wrap { value: Item { value: n } }';when 'argument';'payload';else;'Item { value: n }';end
  suffix=form=='nested_literal' ? '.value.value' : '.value'
  params=form=='argument' ? 'n, payload' : 'n'
  extra=case form
   when 'other_key';"#{row}[1] = Item { value: n + 1 }"
   when 'scalar';"#{row}[0] = n #{row}[0] = Item { value: n }"
   when 'read_root';"let exposed := state assert_equal(#{row.sub('state','exposed')}[0].value, n)"
   when 'error';"mut caught := false try { #{row}[0] = Item { value: [1][99] } } except e { caught = true } assert(caught)"
   else;'';end
  owner=<<~KUJO
   struct Item { value: int }
   struct Wrap { value: Item }
   mut seed := #{seed} mut j := 0 while j < #{width} { #{insert} j += 1 }
   #{declaration} seed = null
   #{form=='shared' ? 'let held := state' : ''}
   export func snapshot() { return state }
   #{form=='shared' ? 'export func old() { return held }' : ''}
   func observe(n) { assert_equal(#{row}[0].value, n - 1) return n }
   export func edit(#{params}) { #{row}[0] = #{replacement} #{extra} return n }
  KUJO
  source="from owner import snapshot, edit#{form=='shared' ? ', old' : ''}\nstruct Item { value: int }\nmut i := 0 while i < #{calls} {\n"
  source+="let saved := snapshot()\n" if form=='fresh'
  source+="assert_equal(edit(i + 1#{form=='argument' ? ', Item { value: i + 1 }' : ''}), i + 1)\n"
  if form=='fresh'
   saved=row.sub('state','saved');source+="assert_equal(len(#{saved}), #{width}) mut j := 0 while j < #{width} { if j == 0 { assert_equal(#{saved}[j].value, i) } else { assert_equal(#{saved}[j].value, 0) } j += 1 }\n"
  end
  final=row.sub('state','final');source+="i += 1 }\nlet final := snapshot()\nassert_equal(len(#{final}), #{width}) assert_equal(#{final}[0]#{suffix}, #{calls})\nmut j := 1 while j < #{width} { #{form=='other_key' ? "if j == 1 { assert_equal(#{final}[j].value, #{calls+1}) } else { assert_equal(#{final}[j].value, 0) }" : "assert_equal(#{final}[j].value, 0)"} j += 1 }\n"
  if form=='shared'
   old=row.sub('state','saved');source+="let saved := old() assert_equal(len(#{old}), #{width}) j = 0 while j < #{width} { assert_equal(#{old}[j].value, 0) j += 1 }\n"
  end
  source+="print(\"STRUCT FALLBACK PASS\")\n"
if payload != 'struct'
 convert=->(s) {
  s=s.gsub(/(?<!struct )Item \{ value: ([^{}]+) \}/) { payload=='array' ? "[#{$1}]" : "{\"value\": #{$1}}" }
  s.gsub('.value',payload=='array' ? '[0]' : '["value"]')
 }
 owner=convert.call(owner);source=convert.call(source)
end
  File.write(d+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(d+'/main.kujo',source)
  sh=Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source);mh=Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(owner);r[:sources][sh]=source;r[:sources][mh]=owner
  meta={shape:shape,payload:payload,form:form,width:width,calls:calls,source_sha256:sh,module_sha256:mh}
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[binary,'run',d+'/main.kujo','--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
   stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="STRUCT FALLBACK PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,exit:status.exitstatus);save.call
  end
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   row=meta.merge(mode:mode)
   probes.each do |kind,probe|
    args=[probe,mode,d+'/main.kujo'];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="STRUCT FALLBACK PASS\n"
    m=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise stderr unless m
    row[kind]={argv:args,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i}
   end
   r[:rows]<<row;save.call
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==432&&r[:semantics].size==648
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

export.rb.text:
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'open3'
o = File.expand_path(__dir__)
sha = ->(p) { Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest }
read = ->(p) { JSON.parse(File.read(o + '/' + p)) }
commit, error, status = Open3.capture3('git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
raise error unless status.success?
acceptance = read.call('acceptance-receipt.json')
raise 'Unaccepted' unless acceptance['status'] == 'accepted'
acceptance['evidence_hashes'].each { |p, h| raise p unless sha.call(o + '/' + p) == h }
%w[source-manifest.json additional-test-manifest.json].each do |manifest|
  read.call(manifest).each do |p, h|
    text, error, status = Open3.capture3('git', 'show', commit.strip + ':' + p)
    raise p + error unless status.success? && Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(text) == h
  end
end
result = {status: 'accepted', runtime_commit: commit.strip, baseline_runtime_commit: '18ebd21', acceptance: acceptance, reports: {}, sources: {}, audit_sources: {}, logs: {}, checksums: {}, limits: 'Bounded scalar-first and scalar-only array batches only. Unsupported selectors, capture materialization and representation review remain open. Local RSS/timings are diagnostic; no production-size or competitive speed claim.'}
%w[normal-artifact-selection.json build-state.json source-manifest.json additional-test-manifest.json scalar-controls.json scalar-controls-verified.json batch-controls/report.json batch-verified.json boundary-controls/report.json boundaries-verified.json fallback-controls/report.json fallback-verified.json verifier-rejections.json broad-verification.json memory-controls.json memory-verified.json memory-review.json].each { |p| result[:reports][p] = read.call(p) }
paths = Dir[o + '/**/*.kujo']
read.call('scalar-controls.json')['rows'].each do |row|
  p = row.fetch('baseline').fetch('path')
  paths += [p, File.dirname(p) + '/owner.kujo']
end
paths.uniq.each { |p| result[:sources][p] = {sha256: sha.call(p), text: File.read(p)} }
(Dir[o + '/*.rb'] + Dir[o + '/historical-gate-repair/**/*'].select { |p| File.file?(p) }).each do |p|
  result[:audit_sources][p.delete_prefix(o + '/')] = {sha256: sha.call(p), text: File.read(p)}
end
%w[library-tests.log integration-tests.log format.log diff.log].each { |p| result[:logs][p] = {sha256: sha.call(o + '/' + p), text: File.read(o + '/' + p)} }
%w[vm interpreter jit].each { |mode| result[:checksums][mode] = read.call('all50-' + mode + '.json') }
result[:benchmark_sources] = read.call('benchmark-source-manifest.json')
File.write('benchmarks/langarena/scalar-first-batches-2026-10-30.json', JSON.pretty_generate(result) + "\n")

final-review-queue.rb.text:
require 'json'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);raise 'Queue exists' if File.exist?(o+'/final-review-state.json')
s={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,stage:'waiting-broad'};save=->{File.write(o+'/final-review-state.json',JSON.pretty_generate(s)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 loop do
  state=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/continuation-state.json'))
  break if state['status']=='review-pending'&&state['stage']=='memory-and-final-review-required'
  raise 'Broad gate failed' if state['status']=='failed'
  Process.kill(0,state['pid']);sleep 5
 end
 %w[verify-source memory-controls verify-source].each do |name|
  s[:stage]=name;save.call
  raise name unless system('ruby',o+'/'+name+'.rb',out:o+'/'+name+'-final.log',err:[:child,:out])
 end
 s[:status]='review-pending';s[:stage]='manual-memory-and-acceptance-review';save.call
rescue=>e;s[:status]='failed';s[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

verify-batch.rb.text:

require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)

if File.file?(o+'/checksum-state.json')
 prior=nil
 loop do
  prior=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/checksum-state.json'))
  break unless prior['status']=='running'
  raise 'Recursive checksum invocation' if prior['pid']==Process.pid
  begin;Process.kill(0,prior['pid']);rescue Errno::ESRCH;raise 'Checksum process gone; inspect retained evidence';end
  sleep 10
 end
 raise 'Previous checksum failure; inspect retained evidence' unless prior['status']=='passed'
 raise 'Source identity' unless system('ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb')
 JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/benchmark-source-manifest.json')).each{|p,h|raise 'Benchmark source drift '+p unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 expected=JSON.parse(File.read('benchmarks/langarena/test.json')).sort_by{|x|x['name']}
 raise 'Expected corpus cardinality' unless expected.size==50&&expected.map{|x|x['name']}.uniq.size==50
 %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
  r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/all50-'+mode+'.json'))
  raise 'Checksum identity' unless r['runtime']==mode&&r['binary']==o+'/candidate-kujo'
  raise 'Checksum corpus' unless r['results'].map{|x|x['config']}.sort_by{|x|x['name']}==expected
  r['results'].each do |x|
   lines=x['stdout'].lines.map(&:chomp)
   raise 'Checksum output' unless x['status']=='passed'&&x['exitcode']==0&&x['runtime']==mode&&x['name']==x['config']['name']&&!x['stdout_truncated']&&!x['stderr_truncated']&&lines.count(x['name']+': OK '+x['config']['checksum'].to_s)==1&&lines.count('Summary: 1, 1, 0')==1
  end
 end
 puts 'Reusing exact matching150-case checksum evidence'
 exit 0
end
s={status:'running',pid:Process.pid};
save=->{File.write(o+'/checksum-state.json',JSON.pretty_generate(s)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 raise 'Source identity' unless system('ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb',out:o+'/production-source-checksum.log',err:[:child,:out])
 b=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/build-state.json'));raise 'Binary identity' unless Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/candidate-kujo').hexdigest==b['binary_sha256']
 sources=Dir.glob('benchmarks/langarena/**/*.kujo').push('benchmarks/langarena/test.json').to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]}
 File.write(o+'/benchmark-source-manifest.json',JSON.pretty_generate(sources))
 %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
  s[:stage]=mode;save.call
  path=o+'/all50-'+mode+'.json';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(path)
  args=[o+'/candidate-kujo','run','benchmarks/langarena/profile.kujo','--scheduler-no-timeout',o+'/candidate-kujo','benchmarks/langarena/test.json',path,'600000',mode]

  r=JSON.parse(File.read(path));raise 'Checksum result '+mode unless r['results'].size==50&&r['results'].all?{|x|x['status']=='passed'}
 end
 sources.each{|p,h|raise 'Source drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 s[:status]='passed';s[:stage]='all150';save.call
rescue=>e;s[:status]='failed';s[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
